groups.title: Eye Drops (A26400COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for discomfort while wearing soft or hard contact lenses, tear supplementation (dry eye), eye fatigue and blurred vision (when there is a lot of eye discharge).
groups.usage: Instill 2 to 3 drops into the eye as 1 dose, 5 to 6 times in 1 day.
groups.caution:
Before using this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have hypersensitivity to it, an allergic constitution, severe eye pain or glaucoma.

When it is given to a child, give it under the supervision of a guardian.

Keep to the stated dosage and schedule.

Use this medicine in the eye only.

Use this medicine only once after opening it (single-use packs only). At the first use, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them.

Do not share it with other people.

Do not use a product that is past its expiry date, and even within the expiry date use it promptly once it has been opened.

groups.title: Eye Drops (180137COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for allergic conjunctivitis.
groups.usage: Adults: instill 1 drop into the eye as 1 dose, 2 to 4 times in 1 day, or as appropriate for the condition. For infants and children, follow the doctor's prescription.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you have hypersensitivity to it, or if the user is a child under 1 year of age.

Before using this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are receiving allergy treatment such as desensitisation therapy; if you have had an allergic reaction to a medicine; if you have eye pain with itching; if it is not clear whether your symptoms are allergic; or if you are pregnant or breast-feeding.

Drowsiness or sedation may rarely occur after use, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.

Keep to the stated dosage and schedule.

Use this medicine in the eye only.

If the tip of the container touches the eyelid or the eyelashes, the solution may be contaminated or become cloudy through eye discharge or fungi, so keep the tip from touching the eye directly. Do not use a solution that has become cloudy.

To prevent contamination, do not share it with other people.

If you wear contact lenses, remove the lens before instilling this medicine and put the lens back in at least 15 minutes after instillation.

If your symptoms do not improve after about 1 week of use, stop using it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

groups.title: Eye Drops (331800COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for dry eye caused by insufficient tear secretion and lack of mucus.
groups.usage: Depending on the irritation symptoms in the eye, instill 1 to 2 drops into the eye as 1 dose, several times in 1 day. Discard any remaining solution and the container immediately after instillation.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you have hypersensitivity to it.

Use this medicine in the eye only.

To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with other people as far as possible.

After opening, use it only once and immediately, and discard any remaining solution and the container straight away (single-use packs only).

groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for conjunctivitis (epidemic eye inflammation), stye, blepharitis (soreness of the eyelid) and itching of the eye.
groups.usage: Instill 1 to 3 drops into the eye as 1 dose, 3 to 6 times in 1 day.

Use this medicine in the eye only.

Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses, and do not use it while wearing soft contact lenses.

To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with other people as far as possible.

groups.title: Eye Gel (124203COO)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for the relief of dry eye symptoms.
groups.usage: Adults: depending on the severity of the symptoms, instill 1 drop into the conjunctival sac as 1 dose, 2 to 5 times in 1 day, and instill it about 30 minutes before going to bed. Treatment of dry keratoconjunctivitis generally needs long-term or continuous treatment, so you should consult an ophthalmologist.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you have hypersensitivity to it.

Before using this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have severe eye pain; if you have had allergic symptoms caused by eye drops (redness of the eye, itching, swelling, reddening of the skin and the like); if you are pregnant, may be pregnant or are breast-feeding; if the user is a child; or if you have corneal damage.

Keep to the stated dosage and schedule.

Use this medicine in the eye only.

Remove contact lenses before use and put them back in 30 minutes after instilling this medicine.

If you use other eye drops at the same time, leave an interval of at least 15 minutes between them and always use this medicine last.

Blurred vision may occur after use, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.

Instill it in small drops to avoid sticking of the eyelids.

If the tip of the container touches the eyelid or the eyelashes, the solution may be contaminated or become cloudy through eye discharge or fungi, so be careful, and do not use a solution that has become cloudy.

To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with other people as far as possible.

groups.title: Eye Drops (228834COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for vernal keratitis or conjunctivitis and for allergic conjunctivitis.
groups.usage: Instill 1 to 2 drops into the eye as 1 dose, 4 times in 1 day (morning, noon, evening and before going to bed). Increase or reduce the amount as appropriate for the symptoms.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you have hypersensitivity to benzalkonium chloride.

Before using this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant.

Avoid wearing soft contact lenses while you are using it.

Use this medicine in the eye only.

Do not use any remaining solution once 1 month has passed since the container was opened.

groups.title: Eye Drops (180138COS)
groups.efficacy: This is an over-the-counter medicine used for allergic conjunctivitis.
groups.usage: Adults: instill 1 drop into the eye as 1 dose, 2 to 4 times in 1 day, or as appropriate for the condition. For infants and children, follow the doctor's prescription.
groups.caution:
Do not use this medicine if you have hypersensitivity to it, or if the user is a child under 1 year of age.

Before using this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are receiving allergy treatment such as desensitisation therapy; if you have had an allergic reaction to a medicine; if you have eye pain with itching; if it is not clear whether your symptoms are caused by an allergy; or if you are pregnant or breast-feeding.

If you have experienced blurred vision after instillation, do not drive or operate machinery until your vision is clear again.

Drowsiness or sedation may rarely occur, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.

If your symptoms do not improve after about 1 week of use, stop using it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep to the stated dosage and schedule.

Use this medicine in the eye only.

To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with other people as far as possible.

If you use this medicine together with other eye drops, leave an interval of at least 5 minutes between them.

Do not use it while wearing soft lenses, and put the lens in at least 15 minutes after use.

If your symptoms do not improve after 3 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Discard any remaining solution and the container after instillation.
